title: In Vitro Anti-Inflammatory Activity of Three Peptides Derived from the Byproduct of Rice Processing.
authors: Qu, Tingmin; He, Shuwen; Ni, Ce; Wu, Ying; Xu, Zhou; Chen, Mao-Long; Li, Honghui; Cheng, Yunhui; Wen, Li
journal: Plant foods for human nutrition (Dordrecht, Netherlands)
one_liner_zh: 该研究从碎米蛋白中筛选抗炎肽，纯实验与生物信息学预测，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI/物理模拟结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Inflammation is a contributing factor to the initiation and progression of many diseases, and some food-derived biofunctional peptides show high anti-inflammatory activity. In our previous study, we demonstrated that peptides derived from trypsin hydrolysis of rice protein show good immunological activity. In the present study, proteins of broken rice were extracted and identified by macroporous resin fractionation and liquid chromatography/tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS). Subsequently, a bioinformatics prediction and in silico simulation approach was used to screen for peptides showing anti-inflammatory activity, including inhibition of the production of nitric oxide and proinflammatory cytokines (interleukin-1beta, interleukin-6, and tumor necrosis factor-alpha) by lipopolysaccharide-stimulated RAW264.7 mice macrophages. Three peptides (DNIQGITKPAIR, IAFKTNPNSMVSHIAGK, and IGVAMDYSASSKR) that demonstrated the highest binding affinity were synthesized, and their in vitro anti-inflammatory activity was investigated. This is the first study that integrates LC-MS/MS identification and bioinformatics prediction for reporting the anti-inflammatory activity of anti-inflammatory peptides derived from broken rice protein. The study findings revealed that the peptides derived from the byproduct of rice milling could be potentially used as natural anti-inflammatory alternativities.
abstract_zh: 炎症是许多疾病发生和发展的重要因素，一些源自食物的生物功能肽显示出较高的抗炎活性。在我们先前的研究中，我们证明了通过胰蛋白酶水解米蛋白得到的肽具有良好的免疫活性。在本研究中，提取了碎米中的蛋白质，并通过大孔树脂分级和液相色谱/串联质谱（LC-MS/MS）进行鉴定。随后，采用生物信息学预测和计算机模拟方法筛选具有抗炎活性的肽，包括抑制脂多糖刺激的RAW264.7小鼠巨噬细胞产生一氧化氮和促炎细胞因子（白细胞介素-1β、白细胞介素-6和肿瘤坏死因子-α）。合成了三种结合亲和力最高的肽（DNIQGITKPAIR、IAFKTNPNSMVSHIAGK和IGVAMDYSASSKR），并研究了其体外抗炎活性。这是首次将LC-MS/MS鉴定与生物信息学预测相结合，报道源自碎米蛋白的抗炎肽的抗炎活性。研究结果表明，源自大米加工副产物的肽可能作为天然抗炎替代品具有潜在应用价值。
